intervals.quote: At 5 pm on Friday 10 February 2017, the wholesale, or spot price for electricity reached $12 915/MWh in New South Wales and $12 221/MWh in Queensland. While the spot price fell significantly in Queensland by 5.30 pm, in New South Wales it increased, reaching $13 967/MWh at 5.30 pm and $14 000/MWh at 6 pm.
